A secure and user-friendly solution that allows you to manage all your meeting and calendar integrations on a single platform.

Get Started

Multi-Platform Integration

Manage Zoom, Google Calendar, Microsoft Teams, and Outlook Calendar all from a single screen.

Automatic Meeting Creation

Generate Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams meeting links instantly and automatically add them to your selected calendars.

Availability Check

View available time slots across all your calendars on a single screen for perfect timing.

Security and Data Protection

Protect your account information and data with current security standards such as OAuth 2.0 and TLS/HTTPS.

How It Works

1

Sign In

Start using Secured Integrations by easily signing in with your Google or Microsoft account.

2

Connect Integrations

Connect your Zoom, Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, and Microsoft Teams accounts with a few clicks from the "Integrations" page.

3

Create Meetings

Go to the "Meetings" page and select a date and time. When you choose Zoom, Google Meet, or Teams as the location, a link is automatically generated.

4

Calendar Synchronization

Your meeting details are automatically added to your connected calendars (Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar). View all your meetings from a single panel.

5

Secure Management

All credentials, Client IDs, and Client Secrets are securely stored. Your meeting and calendar data are always protected.
